conventions.relations: {a-,a+}=1, [b_k-,b_l+]=delta_kl, [b_j^s, a^sigma] = -gb[a sigma, b j s] * kappa, kappa odd central, kappa^2=0
conventions.basis: super-symmetrised quadratics: N_a = a+a- - 1/2, N_k = b_k+ b_k- + 1/2, E[root] = normal-ordered monomial
conventions.deformed_bracket: [Z_i, Z_j]_gb = sum_k c[i][j][k] Z_k + s0[i][j]*1 + kappa*( sum_k gamma[i][j][k] Z_k + s1[i][j]*1 ), kappa on the LEFT

conclusion: Every inhomogeneous deformation gamma_gb of C(n+1) is trivial: gamma_gb = delta f_gb for the explicit odd map f_gb; no condition on gb is needed.  gamma_gb is a NONZERO coboundary whenever gb != 0.
